login.title: Login
login.description: Enter your email address or username and your password to log in to an existing account. Logging in is required to perform actions in this service.

signup.title: Create account
signup.description: Create an account by providing an email address, a username, and a password. You will need these credentials to log in later.

description.initial: If you forgot your password, enter the email address of your account below. A message with a link to reset your password will be sent to this address.
description.sent: A link to reset your password has been sent to your email address.

description.reset: Your password has been reset. You can now log in with your new password.

not_verified.title: Email not verified
not_verified.description: A verification email was sent to your email address.

description.success: Your email address has been verified. You can now use your account.
description.failure: The link used may have expired or is invalid. Please try again.

settings.title: Language models
settings.description: Use the list below to add new language models to your account. For each new chat, you can choose which language model to use. You must provide a URL to the OpenAI API and optionally an authorization token if required.

hint.update: Replace the current token (not displayed for security reasons)

errors.llm: An error occurred while trying to reach the language model. Speak to an admin.
errors.other: An error occurred while trying to create a conversation.

account.description: Welcome to the account view. All your conversations are bound to this account and visible only to you.

change_email.title: Change email
change_email.description: Change your email address. An email with a verification link will be sent to your new email address, which you must confirm. After that, you can log in again.

reset_password.title: Reset password
reset_password.description: An email address will be sent to you with which you can change your password.

change_conversation_name.title: Edit name
change_conversation_name.description: To change the name of the conversation, enter the new name below.

generic.timeout: Timeout while trying to reach the server
generic.permission: You do not have permission to perform this action
generic.authentication: Your identity could not be authenticated

signup.email_used: Email address is already in use
